start: A member whose number is linked by a check-in; plan '3 months' ends in 12 days

user_sees: Card 'MY MEMBERSHIP', title '3 months'
'Ends 30 Nov · 12 days left'
'<n> days at the gym this month.'
'Pause my plan' / 'Renew my plan'
must_not: A day count that is off by one

steps.action: Six days before the end, open the Workout tab
user_sees: A small card 'Your plan ends on Friday, 6 Nov. Renew at the front desk.'
The Gym tab card amber with 'Renew at the desk before it ends.'
must_not: The card when a renewal is already on record

start: A member with a renewal already paid (next plan on record)

user_sees: 'Next: <plan>, from <date>.'
No amber 'Renew' line
must_not: 'Your plan ends …' card on the Workout tab

start: A member who never checked in by QR, or whose number the gym does not have

user_sees: 'Check in once to link your membership' and 'Scan <gym>'s check-in QR at the gym once. Then your plan or pass, and your visits, show here.'
Or 'Your gym has a different number' / 'Ask the desk to check your name' / 'Your number is shared'
must_not: Someone else's plan shown on a shared number

steps.action: A gym that keeps no plans in MettleUp
user_sees: 'Not available yet' and '<gym> doesn't keep its members' plans in MettleUp yet. Ask the desk.'
must_not: 'No plan yet' said as if the member had none

start: A member whose plan ends today, then ended, then renewed

steps.action: Open 'My gym' on the last day
user_sees: 'Ends today, <date>'
Workout tab: 'Your plan ends today. Renew at the front desk.'
must_not: 'Your plan has ended' on the last paid day

user_sees: 'Your plan has ended', 'Ended <date>', 'Renew at the desk to keep training.'
must_not: The plan still shown as running

steps.action: Desk records a renewal; open again
user_sees: The new plan and its end date; the Workout tab card gone
must_not: The old 'ends soon' reminder still firing

user_sees: Only this member's own plan, visits and personal-training count
must_not: Another member's plan on a shared number
The gym's notes about the member

start: A FITPASS member linked by a check-in

user_sees: Title 'FITPASS member'
'You train at <gym> with FITPASS. There is no plan to renew.'
'Scan the gym's check-in QR when you arrive. The gym counts it as a FITPASS visit.'
must_not: An 'ends soon' card on the Workout tab

start: A pass member who has not checked in yet

user_sees: 'Check in once to link your membership' with neutral words ('your plan or pass')
must_not: Words telling the member to buy a plan

start: A paying member moved to a pass by the desk while an old plan still runs

user_sees: The pass card, not the old plan
must_not: 'Your plan ends …' card on the Workout tab

user_sees: Only this member's own pass and visit count
must_not: Other pass members' names or visits
